answers.question: platform Spår 4: no platform edges (which side the trains stop at)
answers.answer: Still open. No owner, Trafikverket, Västtrafik or Wikipedia source describes which side of the Spår 4 platform trains use; Västtrafik only confirms that läge 4 exists. OSM has a platform ref 'Spår 4' (w45583759) with no stairs or footbridge joined to it, so how it is reached is also unknown.
